LESSON: HADITH ON PLANTING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on dressing (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the lea
Topic 2.3: Hadith on planting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on planting. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What are the dangers of cutting down trees?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
2. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
   In simple words: practise until you can read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
   In simple words: practise until you can plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on planting using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on planting in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on planting to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on planting.
4. Show that you can: read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on planting using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on planting important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read the Hadith on planting trees and crops: “If a Muslim plants a tree or sows a field and men, animals and birds eat from it, all of it is charity from him.” (Muslim),
2. Collect pictures of fruit- bearing plants and crops and display in class,
3. Critical thinking and problems solving: researching skill attained as learners research on the significance of planting trees and crops.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the dangers of cutting down trees?
2. What are the benefits of growing trees and crops?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
2. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
